## Notes
- **Net-reclaim fix (ADR-0270 D4).** `evict_oldest` originally stopped at
  *gross* `target_reclaim`; `try_proposal` measures `tokens_freed` *net*
  of omission placeholders (`OMISSION_ITEM_TOKENS = 8`), so a proposal
  could be `ineffective` while evictable items remained — the last rung
  would surrender early into `CompactionImpossible`. The loop now stops
  on the conservative net estimate and the proposal's `estimate` is the
  same net figure; `ac_r_2_4_2_5_evict_oldest_never_stops_short_of_
  net_reclaim` is the regression.
- **Fixture consequence (ADR-0270 D9).** The new seal gate
  (`CapabilityNotAllowed`, `HandlerIncomplete`) made the bare
  `hh-compiler` test procedure invalid; `procedure_node` now emits the
  closed allowlist + total `abort` handler set — the gate was never
  loosened.
- `edit`-tool anomaly observed again on this run (writes reported
  success but did not persist); all file writes went through
  shell/python and were verified by re-reading/`git diff` — the
  documented operational rule held.
